title: Run kb-tests-windows on main and record the result
goal: The manual kb-tests-windows job has run on a commit of main that holds the current launcher, test_child_survives_a_kill_on_close_job passed in its log, and the _gaps.md entry for the Windows launcher carries a note naming the job.

gates.question: Sign glab in to gitlab.com (`! glab auth login`; it returns invalid_grant now) and say when it is done.

notes: Waits until the suite passes on Windows. Any push to main while the job runs cancels it (auto-cancel of redundant pipelines, jobs interruptible): start it when no push is expected for its whole run.
